discovery_source: exact Phase B activation Git commit tree
discovery_algorithm: enumerate every Git-tracked file matching tracked_path_patterns at the exact activation tree
reject a missing tracked file or an untracked file below a protected pattern
sort paths by raw UTF-8 byte order
compute SHA-256 of each actual working-tree file before Tier 2
repeat enumeration and SHA-256 after Tier 2
require identical ordered path and digest lists
require git diff and git status firewalls to show no protected or rehearsal artifact staged
proof_output: ordered before/after path-digest manifests plus constructor-handle audit

supersedes_for_future_authorization_only.reason: Attempt 003 LOW-06 required an exact before/after Tier 2 comparison window that cannot be confused with separately authorized Phase B setup or closeout writes

comparison_window.prerequisite: all separately authorized Phase B activation/config source changes are committed at the exact activation head and both tracked and untracked working-tree status are clean
comparison_window.before_snapshot: immediately before Tier 2 reservation, after all Phase B setup paths exist and before any Tier 2 process starts
comparison_window.during_window: Tier 2 may write only below its isolated temporary rehearsal root; every repository and protected-pattern write is forbidden
comparison_window.after_snapshot: immediately after the terminal Tier 2 record is sealed and reread, before any Phase B final Clause-Packet review-chain or closeout-manifest artifact is created
comparison_window.equality_domain: the same activation-tree discovered protected path set and the actual bytes of every path in that set
comparison_window.post_window: Phase B final review-chain and its external closeout manifest are created only after equality passes; those separately allowlisted post-window writes do not redefine or excuse a Tier 2 mutation
comparison_window.failure: any dirty prerequisite, path-set change, byte-hash change, untracked protected file, or out-of-window source write stops before Step 3 completion
